name.zh: Global China Program（国际英文学分课程）

languageRequirements.minimum: Non-native English speakers provide one of IELTS 6.0 or above, TOEFL 85 or above, or Cambridge English B2 or above. Chinese-language classes are optional, with placement according to proficiency; no entry HSK score is published on this programme page.

faculty.en: Office of International Education, East China Normal University
faculty.zh: 华东师范大学国际教育中心留学生办公室

overview.en: A semester visiting programme for current college students, combining English-taught China Studies content courses with optional Chinese-language study. The Spring 2027 cohort studies at Putuo Campus.
overview.zh: 面向在读大学生的一学期进修项目，在普陀校区学习英文授课的中国研究课程，并可选修中文课程。

qualification.en: Non-degree semester coursework; credit transfer depends on the home institution's academic decision.
qualification.zh: 非学历学期课程；是否认可及转换学分，由学生所在院校决定。

languagePolicy.en: All content courses are explicitly taught in English. Chinese-language classes are optional; their teaching medium is not separately stated, so the English-medium label here refers to the content-course route. Non-native English speakers must provide the stated English certificate.
languagePolicy.zh: 内容课程明确为英文授课；中文课可选，其授课媒介未另行说明，因此本记录的英文授课标签指内容课程。非英语母语者须提交规定的英语证明。

curriculumHighlights.en: Select 3–4 courses each semester. Content courses carry 3 credits each; the Chinese-language course is listed as 9 credits and is optional. Course availability varies and courses may change or be canceled if enrollment is insufficient.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 每学期选择3—4门课程；内容课程每门3学分，中文课程列为9学分且可选。开课随学期变化，人数不足时可能调整或取消。

curriculumHighlights.en: Courses explicitly marked for Spring 2027 include China and World Economy, Understanding China with Data, History of Modern China, and Chinese Civilization: An Introduction. These are course options within this programme, not separate degree programmes.
curriculumHighlights.zh: 明确标注2027年春季开设的选项包括中国与世界经济、以数据理解中国、中国近现代史和中国文明导论，均为本项目内部课程。

eligibility.en: The programme is open to current college students who wish to study in China for one semester.
eligibility.zh: 面向希望在中国学习一学期的在读大学生。

eligibility.en: Non-native English speakers must provide IELTS 6.0 or above, TOEFL 85 or above, or Cambridge English B2 or above. These are alternative certificates.
eligibility.zh: 非英语母语者须提供雅思6.0及以上、托福85及以上或剑桥英语B2及以上证明，三者为替代选项。

eligibility.en: Provide the required school graduation certificate and college transcript, plus a passport valid for the entire study period. The programme page does not publish an age threshold or a separate minimum HSK score; confirm any individual additional requirements with ECNU.
eligibility.zh: 须提供要求的毕业证明、大学成绩单及覆盖整个学习期的有效护照。项目页未公布年龄门槛或单独的最低HSK成绩，个别补充要求请向学校确认。

applicationMaterials.en: Copy of a high-school or college graduation certificate, and a college transcript.
applicationMaterials.zh: 高中或大学毕业证明复印件及大学成绩单。

applicationMaterials.en: Proof of English proficiency for non-native speakers: IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL 85+, or Cambridge English B2+.
applicationMaterials.zh: 非英语母语者的英语证明：雅思6.0以上、托福85以上或剑桥英语B2以上（均含所列门槛）。

applicationMaterials.en: Passport copy valid throughout the full study period. In principle, passport-information updates are not accepted before enrollment and registration.
applicationMaterials.zh: 护照复印件，有效期须覆盖整个学习期；原则上入学报到前不受理护照信息更新。

applicationMaterials.en: Electronic ID photo without headwear, meeting passport-photo requirements; it will be used for the campus card.
applicationMaterials.zh: 符合护照相片要求的电子免冠证件照，用于制作校园卡。

campus.en: Putuo Campus (Downtown Campus), East China Normal University, Shanghai
campus.zh: 华东师范大学普陀校区（上海）

notes.en: Spring 2027 runs from 1 March to 11 June 2027 (15 weeks). The first week is orientation; classes start on 8 March. The application deadline is 25 December 2026; no exact opening date or cutoff time is published for this programme. The separate 20:00 cutoff on the Chinese-language programme page is not used here. Tuition is CNY20,000 per semester, with a separate non-refundable CNY800 application fee. Insurance is listed as CNY800 per year; the guide does not state a prorated semester insurance price or a tuition-refund schedule for this programme. The programme is for current college students. Non-native English speakers need one of IELTS6.0+, TOEFL85+ or Cambridge EnglishB2+. All content courses are taught in English. Select3–4 courses; Chinese classes are optional and offered from beginner to advanced levels with placement based on proficiency. The official page lists9credits for Chinese and3credits per content course. Course availability can change or be canceled when enrollment is insufficient. Four named content options are explicitly marked Spring2027. Credit transfer requires advance consultation with the home institution, whose academic advisers make the final recognition decision. Register online, complete the form and pay the application fee; accepted students receive the Admission Notice and Visa Application Form by email. Students may apply for a campus dormitory or rent off-campus; a room and price are not guaranteed in this guide. Dormitories are described as having air-conditioning and free internet. Complete registration on the university's designated dates. Passport validity must cover study; updates before enrollment and registration are generally not accepted. Contact xywu@gec.ecnu.edu.cn, +86-21-62232013; course-selection questions may go to qsun@admin.ecnu.edu.cn. Do not apply lower fees or closed application dates from a different, older language-version page to this current Spring2027 guide.
notes.zh: 2027年春季项目为3月1日至6月11日，共15周；第一周报到，3月8日开课。申请截止2026年12月25日，项目页未给出明确起报日或当天截止时点；不套用其他中文项目页面的20:00时点。学费20000元/学期，另付800元不退报名费；保险列为800元/年，未公布本项目按学期折算的保险费或学费退款规则。面向在读大学生，非英语母语者须满足雅思6.0、托福85或剑桥英语B2门槛之一。内容课程为英文授课，每学期选3—4门；中文课可选，基础至高级按中文水平分班，官方列中文课9学分、内容课每门3学分。课程随学期变化，人数不足时可能调整或取消；四门内容课程明确标注2027春季。学分转换须预先咨询本校，最终认可由本校学术人员决定。网上填写申请并支付报名费，录取者通过邮件收到录取通知书及签证申请表。可申请校内宿舍或校外租住，简章未保证房源或公布房价；宿舍介绍包括空调及免费网络。按学校指定日期报到。护照须覆盖学习期，原则上报到前不受理信息更新。咨询：xywu@gec.ecnu.edu.cn，+86-21-62232013；选课咨询qsun@admin.ecnu.edu.cn。其他语言旧版页面的较低费用和已关闭申请日不用于本次春季项目。

evidence.derivation: English is proven for all content courses; optional Chinese-language classes are separately disclosed.
